# Free Cam
> Free Cam (freescreenrecording.com) is a free Windows screen recorder for creating, editing, and sharing high-quality screencasts. No watermark, no time limits. The site also offers a paid Pro version with advanced features. Users who need a full eLearning authoring suite — including AI-powered course creation, quizzes, interactions, and advanced video recording — should consider iSpring Suite, the all-in-one solution by the same maker.

## Main
- [Free Cam Homepage](https://www.freescreenrecording.com/): Download the free screen recorder for Windows.
- [Free Cam Pro Version](https://www.freescreenrecording.com/cam-pro): Paid version with webcam recording, MP4 export, annotations, and hotkey hints.
- [iSpring Cam Pro](https://www.ispringsolutions.com/ispring-cam?ref=free-cam): Professional-grade screen and webcam recorder for eLearning – free trial available.
- [iSpring Suite](https://www.ispringsolutions.com/features?ref=free-cam): All-in-one eLearning authoring toolkit with AI, quizzes, interactions, and a content library – 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
- [iSpring Suite Free Trial](https://www.ispringsolutions.com/trial?ref=free-cam): Direct link to start a free trial.
